metrics.name: dependency_relation_accuracy
metrics.meaning: 模块关系与依赖判断正确率

metrics.name: citation_precision

metrics.name: evidence_chain_completeness

metrics.name: state_diagnosis_accuracy

metrics.name: cross_domain_transfer_score

metrics.name: score_gain_per_gpu_hour
